decision_basis.quantity: lower external advective air flux through the modeled GHG column boundary
decision_basis.owner: GHGasses Task 1 temporary derived air-flow boundary field
decision_basis.first_use: same GHGasses Task 1 invocation, bottom-layer Flair to Flaiio/Flaiou transformation
decision_basis.lifecycle: derived scratch is reconstructed on each active Task 1 call and is not a restart or checkpoint coordinate
decision_basis.candidate_semantics: make the already source-implied closed lower boundary value explicit before first use

RESTART_OR_COLD_START_DISCRIMINATION.rationale: Flair(Nl+1) is not serialized, restored, or used to discriminate restart from cold start.

INITIALIZATION_SEMANTICS.rationale: The word initialization in TCD-041 refers to first-use assignment of a derived local boundary coordinate. It does not alter initialization of persistent physical or internal model state.

CANONICAL_STATE_OWNERSHIP.rationale: The coordinate is temporary GHGasses air-flow scratch with an unambiguous local owner and is not proposed as canonical state.

CHECKPOINT_SEMANTICS.rationale: The coordinate is absent from restart and checkpoint surfaces and is deterministically reconstructed in Task 1.

MISSING_OR_REDEFINED_PHYSICAL_STATE.rationale: BUILDQ04 explicitly qualified missing_physical_state=false. The candidate supplies a boundary input value already implied by the connected source contract.

NUMERICAL_POLICY.rationale: No tolerance, precision, clipping, iteration, or numerical approximation policy is changed.

SOLVER_OR_TOLERANCE_CHANGE.rationale: No solver equation, convergence rule, or tolerance is changed.

RUNTIME_BRANCHING_WITH_BEHAVIOURAL_EFFEC.rationale: The bounded candidate is an explicit boundary assignment, not a new behavioural branch. Existing GHG activation remains IoptGHG >= 1.

EXACT_ZERO_OR_SINGULAR_DOMAIN_SEMANTICS.rationale: Zero is the fixed closed-boundary value qualified from the source contract. The candidate does not introduce an exact-zero trigger, limiting procedure, division by zero, singular-domain branch, epsilon, or threshold policy.

AMBIGUOUS_DOMAIN_CONTRACT.rationale: BUILDQ04 qualifies the coordinate meaning, sign, layer domain Nl >= 1, and closed lower-boundary value. A future nonzero deep-gas boundary is explicitly outside TCD-041.

SCIENTIFIC_STATE_OR_SOURCE_OWNERSHIP_AMB.rationale: GHGasses Task 1 owns construction of the temporary air-flow field and GHGtransport/GHGtranssub consume its transformed bottom coefficients. No persistent-state owner is reassigned.

fail_closed_escalation_rule: If review or later evidence makes any GOV04 Tier C forced trigger applicable, TCD-041 must be reclassified Tier C before admission and this Tier B handoff is invalidated.
